Snapshot max4MiB,1024runs,65536glyphs; each bitmap run has one glyph, max1024 pixels/axis. Decoded font-image cache max128entries/4MiB; payload limits are not total COM/process/driver memory.

Optional application font_file uses private DirectWrite collections and native metrics; cache identity includes full Windows file modification time. Missing/oversized (>256MiB) font files fail explicitly.
Monochrome numerical outline/pixel oracle remains explicit color_fonts=false with unchanged tolerances.
Software reference shares image replay and retains fractional bounds; Ui Painter/reference agree for native palette/bitmap fixtures.
--text-controls launches the strict Vulkan controls dialog directly; default Text/IME tab includes multilingual text and colour emoji.
limits: SVG colour glyphs and COLRv1 paint-tree colour rendering are not implemented; no complete arbitrary OpenType colour-format claim.
Live OS IME conversion/candidate interaction and physical input/DPI acceptance remain open.
Current normal/heavy/300s performance must be measured after these font/text changes.
Builds used the current Ui working tree, including preserved unrelated dirty layout files; final clean-main source export qualification will exclude uncommitted foreign edits.
No external Core/Animation changes or publishing.
